Implemented:

- `lib/products.ts` – shared `getCachedProducts` fetcher wrapped in `unstable_cache` with tag `"products"`.
- `app/admin/products/page.tsx` – dynamic admin page at `/admin/products` that renders the cached catalog and includes a regular HTML form with an inline Server Action that calls `updateTag('products')` to invalidate the catalog cache.

The page is server-rendered on demand (`export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`), so the cached catalog is served fast for reads, and any view using `getCachedProducts` (or the same `"products"` tag) will pick up fresh data after a sync. Both `tsc` and `next build` pass.
